null_reading: the same library with every read shuffled, through the same classifier at the same thresholds. It controls one thing: whether base composition alone manufactures a call. It does NOT control misassignment between close relatives, which is the failure that threatens a low-count detection here, and no control in this run does
reading: a classified-read profile of a METATRANSCRIPTOME. A fraction here is a fraction of the RNA that was sequenced, not of the organisms in the water: rRNA content, extraction and depth all sit between the two, and a bacterium with many ribosomes contributes far more reads than its cell count would suggest
bias: Kraken2 over-calls at low confidence, so the fractions at confidence 0 are upper bounds and those at 0.2 lower bounds. The sweep brackets the answer; it does not estimate it. Unclassified is not evidence of novelty - see results/full_residue_search/, where the same reads are searched against protein indexes
panel_note: every entry is reported whether or not it was seen. A not-detected row carries the rule-of-three 95% upper bound over the pairs classified, which bounds what THIS SEQUENCING could have seen. Untargeted shotgun is reported as insensitive for human pathogens at wastewater concentrations, so absence here is much weaker evidence than absence from a targeted assay
